description: Canon facts manifest — the single place to edit a canonical fact. The Prop Bible (02_production/prop_bible.md) is the source of truth for prop/brand/mechanism facts; this manifest lists the discrete, enumerable facts that downstream documents must not contradict. Edit a fact HERE, then run scripts/canon-check.py to find every downstream occurrence that needs updating.

facts.label: The bed's four physical states

pattern.detail: STATE <word> must be one of ONE/TWO/THREE/FOUR. A renamed state (e.g. 'STATE TACO') or a fifth state is a contradiction.

facts.notes: STATE FOUR (FOLDED) is the car configuration — folded in half like a taco, V-shape in the back seat. It is a variation of STATE TWO that exists only for containment.

facts.label: PUSH / PUSH+ tier split
facts.notes: Dave owns the PUSH (Base tier, dark charcoal). Marcus owns the PUSH+ (Premium tier, warm gray). A reference to 'Dave's PUSH+' or 'Marcus's PUSH' is a contradiction.

facts.label: Dave's tier
facts.notes: Dave's bed is the base PUSH: dark charcoal, one PUSH pillow, no duvet.

facts.label: Marcus's tier
facts.notes: Marcus's bed is the PUSH+: warm gray, three PUSH+ pillows, Euro shams, accent pillows, olive duvet, Atmosphere Suite.

facts.label: Product line (spoken vs unspoken)
facts.notes: Timeline: RISE (company) → NUDGE (first gen, Karen, single config) → PUSH/PUSH+ (current, tiered) → MOVE (next gen, unreleased). No model numbers are spoken in the film.

facts.label: Remote model number
facts.notes: The remote model is PM-1 (Push Mode). MDM-1 was the pre-rebrand model name (Morning Drive Mode) and must not appear in current-canon docs.

facts.label: Brand tagline
facts.source: 02_production/prop_bible.md APPENDIX — QUICK REFERENCE (THE RISE / PUSH BRAND IN THREE WORDS)

required_in.detail: A doc that echoes the brand line must use the exact wording 'Simple. Confident. Relentless.'

facts.notes: The three-word brand line. Docs that echo it must use this exact wording.

facts.label: Remote fine print
facts.value: This is a feature, not a limitation.

required_in.detail: A doc that quotes the remote fine print must use the exact wording 'This is a feature, not a limitation.'

facts.notes: The remote's back fine print. Docs that quote it must use this exact wording.

facts.label: Base badge text
facts.value: RISE / The PUSH / Smart Adjustable Base
facts.notes: Dave's bed badge. Exact text, including slashes and spacing.

facts.label: Premium badge text
facts.value: RISE / The PUSH+ / Smart Adjustable Base
facts.notes: Marcus's bed badge. Exact text, including slashes and spacing.

facts.label: Remote dimensions
facts.source: 02_production/prop_bible.md APPENDIX — QUICK REFERENCE (THE REMOTE AT A GLANCE)
facts.notes: The remote is 5 inches high, 2 inches wide, 0.5 inches deep.

facts.label: Bed colorways
facts.notes: Dave's PUSH is matte dark charcoal with cool blue undertone. Marcus's PUSH+ is warm gray (premium colorway).

facts.label: Pillow counts
facts.value: Dave: 1 PUSH pillow + 1 personal pillow. Marcus: 3 PUSH+ pillows + 2 Euro shams + 2 accent pillows (7 total).
facts.notes: Dave = 2 pillows total (1 PUSH hardware + 1 personal). Marcus = 7 total (3 PUSH+ + 2 Euro shams + 2 accent).
